name: GP Anchor Packaging Plant - Janesville WI

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to the former Panoramic Inc. plant (acquired by Anchor Packaging, which Georgia-Pacific acquired Oct 2025) at 1500 N Parker Dr, Janesville WI, in the Arrow Park industrial complex (former Parker Pen site). The roster's geocoded point (42.6442,-88.9605) was ~9 km SSE in open farmland and wrong. Building centroid locked at 42.71205,-89.00955.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open industrial-park facility. North Parker Drive has no gate or fence; the building's parking lots and dock-side driveways are open with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint. Confirmed in Street View 2019-08 from multiple headings. False.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any driveway. False.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Dock apron is accessed by a short driveway directly off North Parker Drive; only room for 1-2 trucks to stack before the apron.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~12 dock doors estimated along the NE face of the building, with ~9 trailers/box trucks backed in (z20 imagery). Low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers stand on the NE dock apron; no marked dedicated trailer-storage lot. Banded 0-10.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single contiguous building (brick 2-story office plus white and green warehouse wings); other buildings nearby belong to separate tenants in the Arrow Park park.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: On the north edge of Janesville (mid-size city) inside the Arrow Park industrial park, with open farmland directly NW. Judged Rural per the rubric's edge-of-town / abutting-farmland guidance; flagged uncertain.
